summary.fdr_scope: all 5 variables x every tested pixel of this box

source: NASA POWER monthly regional API (MERRA-2-based reanalysis and satellite products), 1981-2025, ~0.5 x 0.625 degree grid

regimes.note: Regimes group places with similar combined trends. They describe; they do not prove.

findings: 315 trend tests run. The usual test reports 116 pixels at p < 0.05; after removing month-to-month stickiness, 69 remain at p < 0.05, and 65 pass false-discovery control (10% across every test in this box). Separately, 1 cluster(s) are larger than the largest cluster on 95% of time-shuffled maps of all variables.
Air temperature: warming across 63 pixels around 62.0N, 128.1E (+0.407 degC per decade, cluster shuffle test p = 0.005).
Trend regimes found by clustering: warming + calmer (25 pixels); warming (38 pixels).
caveats: NASA POWER here is MERRA-2-based reanalysis at about 0.5 degrees: a model constrained by observations, not a direct measurement.
Reanalysis can contain sudden jumps when the satellites feeding it change; a trend can partly be such a jump, especially for wind.
Linear trends only. Clusters show where change is stronger than chance, not why it happened.
